title: Scalar extension of a finite-support limiting product
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring map, and $F:\operatorname{RingSiteModules}(A)\to\operatorname{RingSiteModules}(B)$ a functor whose object function agrees with the specified scalar extension [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. Let $M_p$ be $A$-module sheaves indexed by $p\in\mathbb Z$, and $\pi_p:T\to M_p$ a limiting product fan. Assume there are integers $a,b$ such that $M_p$ is zero whenever $p<a$ or $b<p$. Then there are projections $\rho_p:F(T)\to F(M_p)$ forming a limiting product fan, with $\rho_p(b\otimes x)=b\otimes\pi_p(x)$ at every site object. No condition on the action of $F$ on maps, or flatness of $B$, is required.

proof.text: Evaluate at the one object of the bottom-topology site. Sheafification is invertible there. Remove the zero factors outside the finite interval: restriction and extension by the unique zero-factor maps preserve the universal property.

Commute ordinary tensor product with the finite product using TensorProduct.piRight (or piLeft followed by the tensor symmetry). Transport the limiting fan and its pure-tensor formula through the sheafification unit and the object equalities for F. The empty interval is included.

theorem ringExtension_finiteSupport_product
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    (F : RingSiteModules A ⥤ RingSiteModules B)
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringSiteMap φ) M)
    (M : ℤ → RingSiteModules A) (T : RingSiteModules A) (π : ∀ p, T ⟶ M p)
    (hπ : IsLimit (Fan.mk T π))
    (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p < a ∨ b < p → IsZero (M p)) :
    ∃ ρ : ∀ p, F.obj T ⟶ F.obj (M p),
      Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk (F.obj T) ρ)) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (U : (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})ᵒᵖ) (b : B) (x : T.val.obj U),
        (ρ p).val.app U (ringExtensionPure φ F hF T U b x) =
          ringExtensionPure φ F hF (M p) U b ((π p).val.app U x)
